verdict.rationale: Anrok documents a filings endpoint that fetches filings, offers filing and payments as a managed service, and associates transactions with tax returns, so a view of filings exists in some form. None of the four elements the story names are documented. missing for 10: a calendar of upcoming returns, per-filing status fields, remitted amounts per filing, downloadable filing confirmations, any UI description of a filings dashboard, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can see the whole filing picture — a calendar of upcoming returns, per-filing status, the amounts remitted, and downloadable confirmations for every return submitted

citations.quote: This endpoint can be used to fetch filings from Anrok.
Filing and payments, done for you
this endpoint also saves the transaction in Anrok and associates it with the appropriate tax return
